verdict.rationale: Braintrust's docs describe online scoring that evaluates production traces automatically as they are logged, running asynchronously with no latency impact. That directly delivers continuous evaluators on live traffic, and it is built on instrumentation that captures every request. Topics adds continuous classification of every trace. Missing for 10: detailed configuration documentation (sampling rates, trace filters, which scorers can run online, alerting on online scores), and independent or hands-on corroboration that online scoring works in practice.
